assumptions: The provided documentation was cut off before the Agents section, so the agent list's field names (id, contact.email, contact.name, last_active_at, created_at) come from general knowledge of Freshdesk and are not confirmed from the source.
The agent list response is assumed to be a plain top-level array of agents; recordsPath '$' stands for that.
I used the Agents list (/api/v2/agents) as the user list. Contacts (customers) are listed separately at /api/v2/contacts and are not included, since agents hold the licences.
Agent last_active_at is assumed to be an ISO 8601 timestamp (the docs say all timestamps are UTC in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ form). Whether it is populated for every agent is unconfirmed.
No status, role or user type field was confirmed for agents, so those are left empty.
Whether the agents list includes deactivated agents was not confirmed.
Listing agents likely requires an admin-level API key; the source says access depends on the key owner's role.
Authentication uses the API key of a personal agent, so it may stop working if that person leaves or is deactivated. No service-account option appears in the source.
The rate limit depends on the customer's plan (the source lists several), so no fixed per-minute number is set. No reset-time header is documented; only Retry-After on 429 responses.
